answer: We formalize a Sybil-resistant protocol where an adversary attempting identity multiplication faces dynamic opportunity-cost bonds coupled with a zero-knowledge verifiable delay function. Any deviation triggering the subgame-perfect slashing matrix initiates an economic spiral of collateral forfeiture. This mechanism drives the utility of multi-identity generation below zero, steering the network toward a secure summit where honest validation is the unique Nash equilibrium, acting as an oasis against adversarial capital accumulation.
